title: Share one helper between following and followers

findings.detail: changed: data.*.about_me x5, data.*.avatar_url x5, data.*.email x5, data.*.has_password x5, +4 more
findings.label: regression
findings.why: The followers endpoint now returns following relationships due to a typo in _relationship where kind='follower' (singular) is passed but the check expects 'followers' (plural), causing the else branch to return user.following.select() instead of user.followers.select().

findings.label: regression
findings.why: Same root cause as c1: the followers endpoint returns the following list instead of the followers list, changing the entire data array, pagination.count, and pagination.total for GET /api/users/3/followers.

doppel.summary: The refactor introduced a typo ('follower' vs 'followers') that makes the followers endpoint return the following relationship, altering response data for both observed personas.

suspicions.claim: The followers endpoint returns the following list instead of the followers list due to a typo in the helper function parameter check.
suspicions.trigger: Create user A and user B. Make user A follow user B. Authenticate as any user. GET /api/users/<B_id>/followers. Read back the response data array: it will contain user A (correct) only if the bug is not present; with the bug it returns user B's following list (empty or other users).
suspicions.evidence: Probe 'probe_s1_s2_followers_following' for s1 shows GET /api/users/3/followers returned alice as follower in base but empty list in head, confirming the followers endpoint returns following list instead of followers list.

suspicions.claim: The following endpoint returns the followers list instead of the following list due to the same typo in the helper function.
suspicions.trigger: Create user A and user B. Make user A follow user B. Authenticate as any user. GET /api/users/<A_id>/following. Read back the response data array: it should contain user B; with the bug it returns user A's followers list (empty or other users).
suspicions.evidence: Probe 'probe_s1_s2_followers_following2' for s2 shows GET /api/users/3/following returned empty list in both base and head, so the following endpoint does not return followers list.
